comment: Example programs run by `tools/jaic-sweep.py examples` (natively, with the case's args) and by tools/check_scripting_wasm.mjs and tools/check_browser_release.mjs (in the wasm engine, under `budget` basic blocks, the hosted playground's limit). Each line of stdout_contains must appear in stdout; stdout_excludes must not. A case with `bundle` is shipped in the browser bundle: tools/build_scripting_wasm.py copies its directory to <bundle>/ and writes the <bundle>.json index (docs/browser/playground.md).
